爱莎贝儿-148CM-L 粉肤 RAD015 芝田遥Shibata Haruka-警察小姐 2026.02.03
我将巷子角落生锈的消防栓变成了冰冷的审讯椅。
她下颌的血线在月光下绷紧，染血的警服下脊梁依旧挺得笔直。
手铐银环深陷进她腕骨，每一次挣动都伴着金属咬合皮肉的闷响。
“眼神不错。”我用枪管抬起她下巴，在颤动的眼睫阴影里看见不屈的火焰，
“但今夜很长，长得足够……把你这身傲骨，一寸寸，焐成我喜欢的形状。”
身型：148CM-L 粉肤

Elsa Babe-148CM-L Pink RAD015 Shibata Haruka-Policewoman 2026.02.03
I turned a rusty fire hydrant in the corner of the alley into a cold interrogation chair.
The blood vessels on her jawline taut in the moonlight, her spine still ramrod straight beneath her blood-stained police uniform.
The silver rings of the handcuffs dug deep into her wrists, each struggle accompanied by the dull thud of metal biting flesh.
"Good eyes." I lifted her chin with the barrel of my gun, seeing an indomitable flame in the shadow of her trembling eyelashes.
"But tonight is long, long enough... to mold your pride, inch by inch, into the shape I desire."
Body type: 148CM-L with Pink skin tone.
